verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only coarse capability scoping: tasks name their required tools, agents delegate only 'when allowed', and MCP tools can be attached per agent with structured configurations. That loosely limits what an agent can do, but nothing documents fine-grained permission controls or any sandboxed execution environment. missing for 10: fine-grained per-tool permission/allow-deny controls, sandboxed or isolated code/tool execution, approval gates, independent corroboration.
